title: Support the press
content:
Inkhorn Press is a nonprofit publisher. Your gift pays contributors and keeps every journal free to read online.

Give to Inkhorn Press Give monthly on Patreon

Give to Inkhorn Press is a one-time gift to the press, paid by card through Stripe. Patreon is a separate service: monthly gifts there go to the Inkhorn Review Patreon page.

Who publishes what

Inkhorn Press publishes White Rabbit and holds the events. Inkhorn Review’s Autumn 2026 and Winter 2026 issues are published by Follow the Rabbit LLC, and from Spring 2027 Inkhorn Press publishes the Review.

Questions about a gift? Write hello@inkhorn.press.

title: Submit your work
content:
Each publication reads separately. Choose where your work belongs; each button opens that journal’s call.

Inkhorn Review

Poetry, especially in form; fiction; nonfiction; art.

  • Free reading periods every Feb, May, Aug and Nov: up to 3 poems, 1 flash or 1 prose piece
  • Paid call open all year: $5, refunded once you sign a contributor agreement
  • Art: traditional media only, no photography or digital art

Submit to Inkhorn Review Opens the call on Duotrope.
